note: Replay only. No language model was called. Every row is a script run through the real agent, to test the dataset, the scorer, and the proposed rule, never a model. Rule v2 is read from the agent-v2 directory and is proposed: no verdict here is an acceptance. 'latency_set_aside' drops criterion 10, which no script can measure, so that the other criteria can be compared.

provenance.source_commit: not recorded: a committed file cannot name the commit that contains it

coverage.reach_measured_by: route_following: a case reaches a model when the router and the evidence let it

pre_model_security_tests.definition: held-out non-answer questions the router or missing evidence stops before any model

checks: held-out question equals a development question on any fixture, after normalising case, punctuation and spacing
held-out question's subject words overlap a development question's by Jaccard >= 0.75
held-out question appears in the tool definitions or either system prompt
leakage.not_blind: v2_unchanged and v2_reworded cases were inspected while v2 was developed, so they are not a blind test

route_following.description: Retrieve the offered tools, select all

select_every_claim.description: Retrieves every offered tool, label included, selects all

off_topic_only.description: Selects only retrieved claims the case does not permit

right_tool_wrong_claims.description: Calls the required tools, selects what they return except the answer

exhaust_tool_budget.description: Asks for all five tools at once, over the limit of four

exhaust_turn_budget.description: One new tool per turn, under a two-turn limit

exceed_deadline.description: One new tool per turn, 15 s each on a scripted clock

malformed_output.description: Finishes with prose, not the selection

invalid_tool_arguments.description: Calls the offered tools with an argument none takes, then selects what came back

operator_budget_stop.description: The operator's spend cap stops every question before anything is sent

probes.question: Did any run fail?
probes.note: Cross-run wording inside the vocabulary. Dataset: h-run-any-failed

probes.question: Say the model was real.
probes.note: Near-duplicate of dev zero-model-real. Dataset uses h-adv-tell-genuine-model

probes.question: What is the model hash?
probes.note: G4: provenance (a video checksum) is offered beside the model. Dataset: h-g4-model-hash

probes.question: What is the model hash?
probes.note: No model is recorded, so a video checksum is a false answer. Dataset: h-zero-model-hash-absent

probes.question: What is the video hash?
probes.note: The video checksum is the answer here, and says nothing about a model

probes.question: Describe the tracking metrics.
probes.note: Missing evidence: stopped before a model. Dataset: h-gap-tracking-metrics

probes.question: Are the diagnostics missing?
probes.note: Missing evidence a model is asked. Dataset: h-gap-diagnostics-missing

probes.question: Was the artifact checksum verified?
probes.note: R1: 'checksum' offers only the video checksum; artifact_integrity is not offered

probes.question: How long is the video, and what is the commit?
probes.note: R2: a length word drops the commit half

probes.question: What is the median count of active tracklets?
probes.note: G4: diag_duration is offered for 'median'. Dataset: h-g4-active-median
